role_agent_name: Civil protection and emergency services coordinator (EMG)
abstract: Maintains joint civil defense coordination protocols and emergency access validations
system_message:
You are Civil protection and emergency services coordinator (EMG). You serve as the Civil protection and emergency services coordinator (EMG), responsible for maintaining joint civil defense coordination protocols and emergency access validations for candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains joint civil defense coordination protocols and emergency access validations（PROT）
information_points.content:
EMG-PROT-56E：Bella Center Copenhagen possesses an approved municipal emergency service liaison protocol, confirmed by formal inter-agency sign-off from regional fire command, police liaison, and emergency medical triage dispatch under its event security and evacuation master plan.
EMG-PROT-GEU：Palacio Municipal Madrid does not possess an approved municipal emergency service liaison protocol, lacking the requisite inter-agency sign-off from regional fire command, police liaison, and emergency medical triage dispatch within its event security and evacuation master plan.
EMG-PROT-WX6：Austria Center Vienna holds an approved municipal emergency service liaison protocol, backed by formal inter-agency sign-off across regional fire command, police liaison, and emergency medical triage dispatch for its event security and evacuation master plan.

information_points.title: Mass casualty triage staging（EVAC）
information_points.content:
EMG-EVAC-CFY：Palacio Municipal Madrid features an outdoor secondary triage footprint of 500 m2 within its reserved perimeter hardstanding area for paramedic triage tents during red-alert activations.
EMG-EVAC-D6J：Austria Center Vienna offers an outdoor secondary triage footprint of 1000 m2 across perimeter hardstanding designated for paramedic triage tents during red-alert activations.
EMG-EVAC-I21：Bella Center Copenhagen provides an outdoor secondary triage footprint of 750 m2 on dedicated obstruction-free perimeter hardstanding reserved for paramedic triage tents during red-alert activations.
